title: Concept: GraphQL playground served
description: A GraphQL playground page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The playground gives an interactive schema explorer and query runner to anyone who loads it, which turns schema discovery into a form the page fills in for them.
applicability: Deployments that render a GraphQL playground page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The playground gives an interactive schema explorer and query runner to anyone who loads it, which turns schema discovery into a form the page fills in for them.
